data.name: Mairah
data.gender_notes: Mairah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A gentle, delicate name derived from the Arabic word 'Mairah' meaning 'to be gentle or kind'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess soft and tender traits, making them well-loved and cherished. The name Mairah carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Mairah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to the gentle and loving nature of Allah towards His creation. It is a reminder to be kind and compassionate towards others.
data.etymology: Mairah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mairah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: ميرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: ميرة هي اسم علم مؤنث عربي الأصل، ويُعتقد أنَّهُ مشتق من الكلمة العربية القديمة التي تعني المرأة الجميلة والصغيرة، وهي كلمة تحمل دلالات إيجابية في الثقافة الإسلامية، وتُستخدم لوصف الأنثى الجميلة وال لطيفة، وتُعتبر من الأسماء الشائعة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: مائرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مائرہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور چھوٹی خاتون، یہ نام برصغیر کے مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے اور اس کا استعمال اسلامی ثقافت میں بکثرت ہوتا ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کی دلالت ایک خوبصورت اور لطیف خاتون کی ہے

in_hindi.name: मैरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: मैरा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर और छोटी महिला, यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमानों में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसका उपयोग इस्लामिक संस्कृति में बहुत अधिक होता है, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ एक सुंदर और सुंदर महिला का है

in_pashto.name: مایره
in_pashto.long_meaning: مایره د عربي نوم دی چې د ښکلې او کوچنۍ ښځې په معنا دی، دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې ډېر مشهور دی او د اسلامي کلتور کې یې ډېر کارول کیږي، دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د یوې ښکلې او لطیف ښځې په مانا دی

in_english.name: Mairah

Naming a child with such a soft name can symbolize the parents' aspirations for their child to be kind, compassionate, and respectful towards others. The name can be seen as a beautiful reminder of the importance of kindness and good manners in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mairah also holds a spiritual significance for Muslims as it emphasizes the virtues of compassion and mercy, deeply rooted in Islamic teachings. Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) once said, "The Merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful." Therefore, the name Mairah serves as a reminder for Muslims to strive to be kind and merciful towards all creation, and in turn, be blessed with Allah's mercy and blessings. By living this name, girls named Mairah can truly embody the essence of Islamic spirituality and lead a virtuous life.
